title: LeoneMC
body:
**IP: LeoneMC.net | Java & Bedrock Compatible**

### Game Modes (8+ and counting):

- Lifesteal SMP – Steal hearts, dominate the ranks.
- WildKits & InsaneKits – PvP but with random kits.
- Elytra Box – Elytra PvP at its finest.
- Money Dupe Crystal PvP – Fast-paced, high-stakes, CPvP.
- 1.8 Kit PvP & Knockback FFA – Old school combat modes.
- Survival SMP – Chill vibes, active economy.

- New & unique modes added regularly!

### Community Events (10+ every month):
- From Lava Rising, Crystal PvP, to Streamer Hosted events — win epic prizes! (The Event Schedule is posted on the LeoneMC Discord)
